sector_model: Homebuilder (cyclical, balance-sheet driven): P/E on earnings, price to book, gross margin, orders/backlog, net debt to capital; operating cash flow reflects inventory investment.
thesis: Green Brick Partners (NYSE: GRBK). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-28) read. Q3 revenue 448.2M (-8.8%), 9M 1,407.7M (-7.5%); 9M NI attributable 194.3M (-17%); homebuilding gross margin 28.0% vs 32.1% on incentives; Q3 orders +3.1% units but order ASP -4.1%; backlog revenue -17.0% (629 units); cancellation 8.2%. 9M OCF -5.1M as inventory rose 238.3M; debt 304.7M vs cash 100.0M (about 13% of capital); 9M buybacks 34.8M. Close 56.93 (2026-11-20) x 42,432,826 = 2.42B = 8.9x TTM NI 272.6M, 1.20x common book; TTM FCF 69.9M (2.9%).
counterthesis: Low P/E and near-book valuation are typical of peak or falling-margin homebuilders; margins, backlog and prices are all falling, earnings still declining (9M -17%), inventory build consumed cash, and debt rose from near zero to 305M while senior notes are repaid.
invalidation: Downgrade if gross margin falls further, backlog and orders weaken, cancellations rise, or land impairments appear; upgrade case needs margin stabilization.
